raw_text: BREAKING: Chinese Coast Guard vessels deploying water cannons against Philippine resupply boats near Second Thomas Shoal. AIS data shows at least 5 CCG vessels converging on BRP Sierra Madre position. Philippine Navy rotation mission appears to be blocked. Developing situation in the Spratlys.
clean_text: Chinese Coast Guard deploying water cannons against Philippine resupply boats near Second Thomas Shoal. Five CCG vessels converging on BRP Sierra Madre. Rotation mission blocked.
